bio: This family-run institution dating from 1902 is located in a handsome 17C half-timbered building. It is a great place to indulge in hearty food: in the kitchen, dishes simmer under the watchful eye of the chef, who loves his region. Stand-out dishes include local and meat specialties. Expect unpretentious, generous and authentic fare, served in an inviting setting… plus a warm welcome!...
